generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/Category I/Category II(A)/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in Multiple Transaction are liable for rejection
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.
Department will not supply any materials, and the cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KP Procurement Portal.
The Employer reserves the rights reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Chikodi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned
The Tenderer are should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.
Contractors should Registered in KPWD as a Class I/II/III only and copy should be uploaded in E-portal Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.(As per prevailing rates GST will be Paid Separately)
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes (excluding GST) as per prevailing Government Orders.
The Contractor should maintain the Road in good condition till end tender period.
Financial turover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.
If no bid received auto extension will be done by e-proc itself for 2 days.
The contractor should employe only registered labours as per government circular No. PWD/198/HMS/2009/ Dated: 24/06/2009 as per EPF and MP act 1952. In respect of the employ
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) form practicing Chartered Account is preferred.

Appeal as per the Government Ltr No. 572/CRM/2020/PWD-COMM-1-PWD-SEC, Dtated: 09-10-2020 the appeal received in e-proc as per KTTP act/rules within the stipulated time will only the considered. Any written appeal received shall not be considered.

As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3 If the Tenderer is not ready to make aggrement, Then the EMD amount will be forfeited and tender will be rejected

As per Government Circular No. PWD/48/BMS/2022, Dated 31/05/2024 and KTPP 2000 Rules 26(A) contractor are liable for debarment if contractor does bad quality of work, if contractor fails to complete the work within stupilated period of time and also to follow all other conditions mentioned in the above said Government circular.

For ST contractors reservation category participate in the tender, the contractors should upload the domicile certificate stayed in KARNATAKA for minimum of 10 years issued by a competent authority / Tahsildar.

This Tender is invited for the Tenderers belonging to ST category only & to claim this reservation ST category certificate issued by the competent authority should be uploaded & should be submitted in original before tender opening.
If the Contractor is a firm, then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to the ST as the case may be
This tender is reserved for ST Contractors only
The Project Completion period is 6 months (Ecluding Mansoon).1)Mansoon period will be considered As per D code2)Star rates/price adjustment clauses are applicable only for original tender period..

The EMD of Rs. 80,000.00 shall be paid in full through e payment or in two parts i.e. part (1) Rs.50,000.00 by e-payment Part (2) Rs. 30,000.00 EMD shall be in the form Bank Guarantee in the prescribed format obtained from any Nationalised / Scheduled Bank in favour of Executive Engineer, PWD Division, Chikodi payable at Chikodi

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: CONSTRUCTION OF BRIDGE IN BANNIBAGI VILLAGE

itemList.description: Dismantling of Structures - Dismantling  of  existing  structures  like  culverts,  bridges,  retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood  work,  steel  work,  including  T&P  and  scaffolding  wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead - Lime /Cement Concrete - By Manual Means - Lime Concrete, cement concrete grade M-10 and below. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 202

Mechanical Means -
Providing and Filling in foundation with granite / trap broken metal 100mm. and down size & with approved sand including hand packing, ramming, watering, including cost of all materials and labour with all lead and lift complete as per specifications.

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. Foundations of Bridges

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. Sub structure of Bridges
PCC M15 Grade leveling course below approach slab complete as per drawing and Technical specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2700

Reinforced   cement   concrete   M30   grade   for   approach   slab including reinforcement and formwork complete as per drawing and Technical specification (Batching Plant). Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1500, 1600, 1700 & 2704

Providing   weep   holes   in   Brick   masonry/Plain/   Reinforced concrete  abutment,  wing  wall/  return  wall  with  100  mm  dia AC pipe, extending through the full width of the structure with slope of 1V :20H towards drawing foce. Complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2706 & 2200
Providing and laying Cement concrete wearing coat M-30 grade including reinforcement complete as per drawing and Technical Specifications. (Batching Plant). Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2702

Back   filling   behind   abutment,   wing   wall   and   return   wall complete  including  compaction  as  per  drawing  and  Technical Specification - Granular material. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 710.1.4. of IRC :78 & 2200

Providing and laying of Filter media with granular materials/ stone   crushed   aggregates   satisfying   the   requirements   laid down in clause 2504.2.2. of MoRTH specifications to a thickness of  not  less  than  600  mm  with  smaller  size  towards  the  soil and bigger size towards the wall and provided over the entire surface behind abutment, wing wall and return wall to the full height compacted to a firm condition complete as per drawing and Technical Specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 710.1.4. of IRC :78 & 2200

Construction  of  RCC  railing  of  M30  Grade  in-situ  with  20  mm nominal  size  aggregate,  true  to  line  and  grade,  tolerance  of vertical RCC post not to exceed 1 in 500, centre to centre spacing between vertical post not to exceed 2000 mm, leaving adequate space  between  vertical  post  for  expansion,  complete  as  per approved drawings and technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2703, 1500, 1600 & 1700
Filler joint - Providing   &   fixing   20   mm   thick   compressible   fibre   board in   expansion   joint   complete   as   per   drawing   &   Technical Specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2605
Drainage Spouts using 100 mm GI pipe complete as per drawing and Technical specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 2705
